text:
alex: heads up — after the console change that added the new rateplan header we started seeing quota attribution mismatches from customer reports :eyes:
priya: can you paste an example request/response?
sam: repro for me was when we set `X-Redwood-RatePlan: enterprise` via the console, console logs show the header but metrics attribute to default quota bucket
maria: interesting — i wonder if the http proxy is folding header case or renaming it. python SDK lowercases headers before send, TS leaves them as-is in some fetch impls.
alex: here is a curl we used to validate:```curl -H "X-Redwood-RatePlan: enterprise" https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate -d '{"model":"..."}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"```
priya: thanks. i ran the same through our internal proxy and saw header arrive as `x-redwood-rateplan` but our route matching rule in the console expects `X-Redwood-Rateplan` (case-sensitive match) so it falls back to default route.
sam: ouch. the console router should be case-insensitive for headers. but changing router now is risky for in-flight rollouts.
maria: short-term mitigation: add a shim in SDKs to normalize to `x-rw-rateplan` canonical name before send, and have console accept either `x-redwood-rateplan` or `x-rw-rateplan` in the policy matcher.
alex: devex concern: many customers use custom proxies and edge platforms that mutate headers, so SDK shim + console tolerant matching sounds safest. also document in changelog.
priya: can we do a tiny canary first? add a backend switch `accept_rateplan_alias` behind a feature flag and enable for 5% of traffic for a day. infra-sre: we can roll that out via the console rollout system, ETA a couple hours to gate.
sam: SDKs: python and go can normalize easily. ts/deno needs a tiny patch across both fetch/node clients. should we release a patch or a compatibility shim in the client proxy?
maria: prefer SDK patch + server tolerance. patch will be non-breaking and logged. add a telemetry event `rateplan_header_normalized` so we can measure how many requests required normalization.
alex: plan proposal:@infra-sre enable server-side alias flag on canary; @devex-bot post new tile in console telemetry for the flag and add an explainer in quickstart; SDK owners push patches for py/ts/go with normalization + opt-in telemetry; monitor for 24h then flip default.
devex-bot: noted — creating console tile draft and changelog blurb (refs #DOCS-472). :robot_face:
priya: testcases: 1) header as `X-Redwood-RatePlan`, 2) `x-redwood-rateplan`, 3) `x-rw-rateplan`, 4) absent header -> default attribution. add e2e using curl and sdk integ tests.
infra-sre: i'll schedule canary at 15:00 UTC, will post when deployed.
sam: quick code snippet for python shim:```headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in headers.items()} if 'x-redwood-rateplan' in headers: headers['x-rw-rateplan'] = headers['x-redwood-rateplan']```
maria: TS shim for `fetch` clients:```const headers = new Headers(orig); const plan = headers.get('x-redwood-rateplan') || headers.get('x-rw-rateplan'); if (plan) headers.set('x-rw-rateplan', plan);```
alex: also add note in rollout UX: when we flip flag to on by default, console should show a banner to org admins reminding of header canonicalization and link to SDK patches.
priya: timeline: today - prepare SDK branches + tests. tomorrow - canary + telemetry. +48h - evaluate and flip if stable.
maria: add a regression alert in Optimize: quota-attribution-change > 1% for orgs with current usage baseline.
alex: thanks team. tagging owners: @priya (platform), @maria (sdks), @infra-sre (deploy). i'll follow up with a short RFC if anything deviates. :thumbsup:
infra-sre: deployed canary flag at 15:02 UTC — watching logs, will report anomalies.
devex-bot: telemetry tile live (canary view) — link: https://console.redwood.run/telemetry/tiles/472/canary
priya: received first batch of normalized events. early signs look good.
sam: pushed python/ts/go branches with normalization + tests, PRs incoming.
maria: i'll own the changelog entries and docs update.
alex: great. we'll reconvene after 24h with attribution diffs. :party_parrot:
